text.en:
Article 341 of the Revised Penal Code is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Art. 341. White Slave Trade. The penalty of prision mayor in its medium and maximum periods shall be
imposed upon any person who, in any manner, or under any pretext, shall engage in the business or shall
profit by prostitution or shall enlist the services of any other person for the purpose of prostitution."
